narration.text: [softly] The man on your television is still talking. [short pause] But that is not his voice. [long pause] Southern England. A Saturday in November, nineteen seventy seven. [long pause] Ten past five. Families sit down to the early evening news. [long pause] Then the sound dissolves into a low hum. [long pause] [whispers] And another voice comes through. [long pause] [softly] For six minutes, the picture never changes. The newsreader's lips keep moving. [long pause] The voice tells everyone to give up their weapons. That there is only a short time left. [long pause] On a hill in Hampshire, one transmitter is passing it on to the homes below. [long pause] Then the news comes back, as if nothing had happened. [long pause] The station apologises. The broadcasting authority calls it a hoax. [long pause] No one was ever identified. [long pause] Nearly fifty years later, no one knows whose voice it was. [long pause] [whispers] Or where it was really coming from.
